name: spiderman-game
description: A 3D Spider-Man web-swinging game built with Three.js in a single HTML file. Features procedural city generation, pendulum swing physics, landmark buildings, multiple suit styles, and dual controls for desktop and mobile.

scripts.build:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && powershell -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Users\Aryan\.jdk21\jdk-21.0.12.1+1'; cd android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug; cd ..; Copy-Item android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk Spider-Man-NYC.apk -Force"
